analysis.purpose: The id grammar: stable, deterministic, human-readable identifiers for every node kind and edge, so the same content always yields the same id across runs and machines.
responsibilities: Derive a deterministic id per node kind
Derive edge ids from their endpoints and relation

businessRules.rule: Same content produces the same id, which is what makes re-indexing incremental and references stable.
businessRules.rationale: Random ids would make every re-index a full rewrite and break every stored reference.

nodes.name: ID grammar
nodes.summary: Deterministic identity for every node and edge.
